review.confirmed_integration: three scales and 8400 priors; shared convolution weights with separate BN/GN; optimizer uniqueness; FP32 backward; eight AMP optimizer updates; finite predictions; EMA swap/restore and strict checkpoint loading
review.structural_change_in_direct_design: Value aggregation becomes channelwise; the dynamic-weight generator still mixes channels. Direct intermediate channel projection is removed at the head and equal-width neck output.
review.revised_neck_output: 1x1 ConvBN Cin->96, LSConv96, original SiLU at all three scales
review.revised_head_layer: LSConv96, 1x1 ConvBN96->96, original SiLU; both sets of convolution weights shared across scales; all norms independent
review.initialization: Standard RTMDet head init resets new LKP convolution standard deviation to 0.01; this differs from constructor initialization. Current tested prototype keeps this policy and passes numerical/update checks; no isolated evidence attributes accuracy to it.

fused_latency.conditions: Shared GPU0, raw PyTorch head output, no NMS/preprocessing; six interleaved samples per model; eval BN fusion

review.limits: Batch2 short check, shared GPU0. No formal batch36 capacity check, accuracy experiment, or deployment/export verification. Only Conv2d and aggregation MACs counted.
review.recommendation: Retain explicit value-channel projections for the expanded candidate. Treat it as parameter/nominal-MAC reduction; current PyTorch latency evidence shows slowdown. Do not label it an acceleration result.
